primary_title: Morphine-mediated release of astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle miR-23a induces loss of pericyte coverage at the blood-brain barrier: Implications for neuroinflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies morphine-altered astrocyte EV miR-23a as a BBB/neuroimmune cargo; the cited primary measures morphine-induced miR-23a enrichment in astrocytes and ADEVs and its transfer to pericytes.
limitations_preserved: Record altered EV miR-23a cargo, not inferred MIR23A transcription or a miR-23a protein step; preserve morphine, hnRNP A2/B1 sorting and BBB/pericyte context.
